title: The Chic Hyve (Pool near the Gulch and Broadway)
description:
You'll have a great time at amenity-rich condo! A pool, lounge area, outdoor kitchen, rooftop, and gym are all included!

The space
Welcome to Hyve, Nashville’s premier condominium, ideally situated just minutes from the Convention Center, Vanderbilt University Medical Center, the Gulch, Broadway, and Downtown. This stylish, fully furnished unit seamlessly combines Scandinavian-inspired design with luxurious comfort.

The thoughtfully designed kitchen is perfect for culinary enthusiasts, while two uniquely styled bedrooms enhance the condo’s charm. The primary suite features a Queen bed, smart TV, and serene pool views. Spacious and inviting, this single-floor condo comfortably accommodates up to 4 guests.

Guest access
Keyless entry to the property via keypad. The details for the the keypad code will be sent to you prior to your reservation.

Other things to note
While the neighborhood is mostly quiet and safe this is still an urban environment and you should always remain aware of your surroundings and use common sense. We recommend that you don't leave valuables in your car and don't leave the doors and windows unlocked when you leave the house.
